summary: Practise alert tuning, risk segmentation, investigations, and STR workflows. Explore the five-day transaction monitoring course and its applied curriculum.
lede: Transaction monitoring training helps AML officers, compliance analysts, investigators and financial-services operations teams review activity and apply risk-based controls. Participants practise customer-risk segmentation, alert analysis and tuning, and evidence-based case documentation. They also work on quality checks and dashboard measures while considering how analytics and automation affect monitoring workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who configure, operate, review, or oversee transaction monitoring in financial services.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of AML/CFT or financial-services compliance is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel; Power BI Desktop is optional for the dashboard exercise. Exercises use illustrative records rather than live customer data.
